claims.source_quote_ar: واو الحال لا بد أن تمتاز عن واو العطف بمزية
claims.claim_ar: الواو في «وَبَطَلَ» تعمل واو عطف توصيلية تربط وقوع الحق ببطلان ما كانوا يعملون، مظهرة التتابع والنتيجة الفورية بين الحدثين ومغايرة واو الحال المذكورة لدى الزمخشري.
claims.claim_en: The waw in «وَبَطَلَ» functions as a coordinating conjunction (waaw of coordination), linking the occurrence of the Truth to the nullification of their deeds — producing immediacy and sequential/resultative effect; distinguished from the 'waaw of hal' discussed by Zamakhshari.
claims.needs_review_reason: Inference based on Zamakhshari's general discussion of واو الحال vs واو العطف in the provided chunk; the chunk does not analyze this specific verse directly, so the assignment of the waw's pragmatic effect to this ayah is interpretive and should be reviewed against other commentaries.

claims.source_quote_ar: وصيرناهم قطعا، أى فرقا وميزنا بعضهم من بعض
claims.claim_ar: بنية الآية تقوم على مقابلة/تضاد بين «وقوع الحق» و«بطلان ما كانوا يعملون»، أي أن الإعلان عن تحقق الحق يقترن بنفي قيمة أعمالهم السابقة لتحقيق أثر بلاغي يقضي على شرعية تلك الأعمال.
claims.claim_en: The verse deploys a contrast (muqabalah) between 'the Truth took place' and 'what they were doing became void' — the announcement of the Truth is paired with the nullification of their deeds, rhetorically cancelling and refuting those actions.
claims.needs_review_reason: Supported indirectly by Zamakhshari's notion of distinguishing/contrasting (e.g., 'ميزنا بعضهم من بعض') in the provided chunk; the chunk does not explicitly analyze this specific verse's contrast, so further review with additional tafsir/balagha sources is advised.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Emphasizes finality and refutation — shows that the truth's occurrence immediately invalidates their prior actions.

warnings: Provided source_chunks are all from Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf). Other requested authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) were not included, so claims rely solely on the available Zamakhshari material.
